---
title: "MCQ to devoirs_choices translation test"
format: html
---

## Translation rules used

- Remove the choice prefix (`1.`, `2.`, `a.`, and so on) from the displayed text.
- Map `[correct]` to `correct: true`; other choices use `correct: false`.
- Map `[hint: ...]` to `feedback: ...`; omit feedback when no hint is given so the package default applies.
- Trim surrounding whitespace from choice text and hint feedback.
- Join a continuation line to the preceding choice with a space.
- Preserve the source `mcq` label and `inline` setting in the comment above each translated chunk. These are not `devoirs_choices` YAML fields; Phase 2 uses them when creating the `devoirs_selection()` call.
- The chunk label is a unique, valid R variable name for the parsed choice list.

## Paired examples

```{r}
#| include: false
library(devoirs3)
```
```{r}
#| echo: false
devoirs3::devoirs_start(docID="tuesday", feedback=TRUE, collector=TRUE)
```


2. Which point is at the lowest output value of the function shown?

`r devoirs_set3(choices = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"), correct = "B", label = "d05-2-low")`

3. Which point is at the highest output value of the function shown?

`r devoirs_set3(choices = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"), correct = "C", label = "d05-3-high")`

````qmd

#| label: dgf-10eks
a. Exactly 1 [hint: Not really. This is a very attractive answer, but there doesn't need to be any angle that will do the job, as with a ping-pong ball.]
b. Exactly 2 [hint: Might be, but doesn't need to be. How might it be? A very shallow angle might work, with the ball skimming the target. At the same time, a steep angle might send the ball up high in the air, giving enough time for its slight horizontal speed to carry it to the target. ]
c. Exactly 0 [hint: This might be the case, but it might not. For instance, you are unlikely to be able to send a ping-pong ball 50 meters no matter what the initial speed and launch angle. Even for a heavier ball, the fixed value of `speed` in the slice might be inadequate. But if the speed were high enough, a heavier ball could well be aimed to reach the target.]
d. It might be any of the above [correct]
```
````
